FP-01.title: Your financial command center
FP-01.subtitle: A shared shell for every financial decision.

sections.title: Money pulse - next 30 days
sections.caption: Illustrative forecast. Select a point to inspect that day.

inspector.title: One clear next move
inspector.text: Findings turn account records into a decision you can inspect.

FP-01.title: Shared interaction patterns
FP-01.subtitle: Every page uses the same visual and behavior system.

sections.title: Form fields - clear labels and units

inspector.title: Loading
inspector.text: Skeletons preserve the layout while records load.

inspector.title: Validation
inspector.text: Keep entered data; highlight the field with an actionable error.

FP-02.title: Welcome back
FP-02.subtitle: Your whole financial picture, in one protected workspace.

sections.title: Demo workspace
sections.text: Use fictional FinPilot credentials. Institution credentials are separate.

FP-02.title: Check your email
FP-02.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code sent to m***@example.test.

sections.title: Use your latest code
sections.text: Sending another code invalidates the previous code.

inspector.title: Local email demo
inspector.text: Mailpit receives messages for fictional addresses. No real inbox is implied.

FP-02.title: That code has expired
FP-02.subtitle: Request a fresh code; your financial session has not started.

sections.title: Safe failure
sections.text: Codes are single-use, expire after five minutes and have an attempt limit.

inspector.title: Too many attempts
inspector.text: Show a timed lockout after the configured attempt limit. Do not reveal account existence.

FP-03.title: Connect your financial picture
FP-03.subtitle: Select an institution category, then a simulated provider.

inspector.title: Your consent stays specific
inspector.text: Choose the exact accounts and records FinPilot can read.

inspector.title: Simulation only
inspector.text: Never enter real banking credentials.

FP-03.title: More financial institutions
FP-03.subtitle: Cover assets and obligations across institution types.

sections.title: Product boundaries
sections.text: Bank-issued credit cards remain under their issuing bank. No real financial account is opened.

FP-03.title: Connect Chase
FP-03.subtitle: Step 1 of 2 - validate your simulated institution login.

sections.title: Simulation only
sections.text: This screen authenticates against the local simulator, never the actual bank.

inspector.title: Invalid credentials
inspector.text: Keep the provider selected, clear the password and show a generic connection error.

inspector.title: App password is different
inspector.text: Do not reuse or transmit the FinPilot application password here.

FP-03.title: Choose the accounts to connect
FP-03.subtitle: Step 2 of 2 - read-only access, controlled by you.

sections.title: Consent
rows: I authorize the selected read-only access

inspector.title: No money movement
inspector.text: Connecting does not authorize payments, transfers, cancellation or purchases.

inspector.title: Disconnected means inaccessible
inspector.text: Agents lose access when consent is revoked.

FP-03.title: Your accounts are connected
FP-03.subtitle: The initial history sync completed successfully.

sections.title: Sync states
sections.text: Syncing / partial / failed / revoked each need a distinct status. Retry is idempotent.

inspector.title: Next step
inspector.text: Review the overview, then run a financial checkup.

FP-03.title: Bringing your records together
FP-03.subtitle: A truthful connection progress state with safe retry.

sections.title: Progress policy
sections.text: Progress comes from real server events. Do not animate a fabricated 100% success. Repeated sync must not duplicate records.

inspector.title: If partially complete
inspector.text: Show which accounts imported and which need retry. Preserve valid records.

inspector.title: Cancel / retry
inspector.text: Define server behavior before exposing a cancel control.

FP-03.title: The connection needs another try
FP-03.subtitle: No successful connection is claimed until validation and consent complete.

sections.title: Could not validate the demo credentials
sections.text: Keep the institution selected, clear the password and allow retry. Use a generic error without disclosing account existence.

inspector.title: No fallback access
inspector.text: Do not expose records from an unselected or different user's account.

FP-04.title: A clearer next move starts here
FP-04.subtitle: A financial picture you can inspect, not just a balance.

sections.title: Money pulse - checking account
sections.caption: Potential Nov 10 shortfall. Select the date for the responsible records.

inspector.title: Timing conflict
inspector.text: Enough money overall can still mean insufficient checking cash on a bill date.

FP-04.title: Accounts with context
FP-04.subtitle: Separate available cash, liabilities and restricted assets.

sections.title: Available cash policy
sections.text: Brokerage, retirement and CD balances are excluded from spendable cash by default.

inspector.title: Account actions
inspector.text: Open history, inspect connection scope or manage sync.

inspector.title: Privacy
inspector.text: Only the last four identifier digits are shown.

FP-04.title: Every transaction, in its place
FP-04.subtitle: Filter by account, date, merchant or category.

inspector.title: Transfers are not extra income
inspector.text: Paired owned-account transfers are excluded from income/spending totals.

inspector.title: 30-month history
inspector.text: Paginate results and preserve filters when opening details.

FP-04.title: Transaction evidence
FP-04.subtitle: Inspect the record behind the finding.

sections.title: Possible duplicate
sections.text: Flag a candidate for review; do not automatically remove an equal-value transaction.

inspector.title: Corrections
inspector.text: The base scope is read-only. Category edits require a later explicit endpoint.

inspector.title: Evidence access
inspector.text: Ownership and connection scope are checked again when opening the record.

FP-04.title: Your month, before it happens
FP-04.subtitle: A calendar of cash obligations and income arrival dates.

sections.title: Dated checking forecast
sections.caption: Shows cumulative end-of-day balance. Same-day ordering is explicit.

inspector.title: Account vs whole picture
inspector.text: Savings does not automatically cover checking obligations.

inspector.title: Forecast assumptions
inspector.text: Only linked accounts, scheduled items and explicit assumptions are included.

FP-04.title: The timing conflict, explained
FP-04.subtitle: Review alternatives before choosing a plan.

sections.title: Candidate options
sections.text: Compare a proposed cash allocation or a revised payment assumption. No transfer or bank schedule is changed by this design.

FP-05.title: Your recurring costs, made visible
FP-05.subtitle: Spot price changes and compare terms before changing services.

sections.title: Do not guess usage
sections.text: Recurring charges reveal payment patterns, not whether you actually use a service.

inspector.title: Three distinct states
inspector.text: Detected candidate / user-confirmed subscription / confirmed changed cost.

inspector.title: Annual renewals
inspector.text: Show full upfront cost as well as monthly equivalent.

FP-05.title: Tell us what you want to keep
FP-05.subtitle: Meaningful savings preserve the features you care about.

sections.title: User confirmation
sections.text: If usage is unknown, ask. Do not label the service unused from payment history.

FP-05.title: Compare the full cost
FP-05.subtitle: Every price needs terms, eligibility and a source.

sections.title: Sample offers - not verified live
sections.text: Show source URL, retrieval time, eligibility, features, promo expiry and renewal terms. Unknown costs stay unknown.

inspector.title: Cash timing matters
inspector.text: A cheaper annual total can still be unaffordable this month.

inspector.title: No double counting
inspector.text: Cancellation and switching are mutually exclusive actions for one subscription.

FP-05.title: Is the annual option worth it?
FP-05.subtitle: Savings and affordability belong in the same comparison.

sections.title: Cost calculation
sections.text: 12 x $18.99 - $189.96 = $37.92. A true first-year comparison also includes known switching/cancellation fees.

inspector.title: Decision
inspector.text: Save a proposal, then confirm a real provider change outside the prototype.

inspector.title: Agent follow-through
inspector.text: Only confirmed changes can be used as available savings in a plan.

FP-05.title: Review your subscription action
FP-05.subtitle: A saved intention is not a completed cancellation or purchase.

sections.title: Proposed action
rows: I understand this saves a proposal only

sections.title: After saving
sections.text: Show Proposed status, a checklist and provider guidance. Do not show Realized savings until confirmed.

inspector.title: External action
inspector.text: The user completes any purchase/cancellation directly with the provider.

FP-06.title: Give every payment a purpose
FP-06.subtitle: Compare payoff choices while reserving bills and a cash cushion.

sections.title: Payment strategy
rows: Highest APR first / smallest balance first

inspector.title: Exact conventions
inspector.text: Debt simulations need a payment date, rate basis, minimum-payment rule and rounding policy.

inspector.title: Interest vs credit readiness
inspector.text: Do not promise a credit score change or loan approval.

FP-06.title: Payoff calculator
FP-06.subtitle: Fixed-rate, equal monthly payments; full assumptions visible.

inspector.title: Validation
inspector.text: Reject negative principal/APR, zero term and non-finite input. APR=0 uses P/n.

inspector.title: Rounding
inspector.text: Use exact cents for posted payments and a capped final payment. Identify any residual.

FP-06.title: Make the goal concrete
FP-06.subtitle: Calculate the contribution required to reach your target.

sections.title: Contribution calculation
sections.text: At 0%: max(0, target - saved) / months, rounded up to the next cent. With APY, convert to an effective monthly rate.

inspector.title: No negative savings requirement
inspector.text: Already-funded goals show $0 and Funded status.

inspector.title: Feasibility
inspector.text: A mathematically valid contribution can exceed the available budget; show the gap.

FP-06.title: Your priorities, coordinated
FP-06.subtitle: Your goals share the same available dollars.

sections.title: Budget conservation
sections.text: Debt extras + goal contributions + additional reserves cannot exceed the same available budget.

inspector.title: Progress is earned
inspector.text: Goal progress uses confirmed funds, not unconfirmed future subscription savings.

FP-06.title: Set a goal that fits your life
FP-06.subtitle: Make the target, deadline and tradeoff explicit.

sections.title: Form errors
sections.text: Reject past deadline, nonpositive target and negative savings; keep entered values after validation errors.

inspector.title: Editing a goal
inspector.text: Increment its version and mark dependent proposals stale.

inspector.title: Budget impact
inspector.text: Show whether the required contribution fits the current monthly budget.

FP-06.title: Choose your next move
FP-06.subtitle: Three coherent allocations; the same monthly budget.

sections.title: Timelines and assumptions
sections.text: Show calculated goal completion, payoff timing and interest by option; never invent dates.

inspector.title: Try the plan
inspector.text: Stress-test an unexpected expense before accepting.

inspector.title: What changes?
inspector.text: Selection changes a proposed allocation only, not bank transactions.

FP-06.title: Review before accepting
FP-06.subtitle: Save your chosen plan with its assumptions and version.

sections.title: Acceptance
rows: I reviewed this allocation and its assumptions

sections.title: Version conflict
sections.text: If a newer version exists, show a refresh action rather than silently overwriting it.

inspector.title: Nothing moves automatically
inspector.text: This saves a financial plan. It does not make a payment or transfer.

FP-06.title: Assets, with their limitations
FP-06.subtitle: A clear picture of savings, maturity and restricted balances.

inspector.title: Expected CD value
inspector.text: $1,050 after one year at 5% APY before taxes or penalties.

inspector.title: Availability
inspector.text: Do not count retirement/CD balances as bill-paying cash by default.

FP-06.title: Rehearse the unexpected
FP-06.subtitle: Test the plan with an explicit change in circumstances.

sections.title: Stress controls
rows: Unexpected expense / delayed income / income drop

sections.title: Baseline and stressed balance
sections.caption: Add the selected event once. Baseline stays unchanged.

inspector.title: No probability claim
inspector.text: This is one scenario, not a prediction of risk.

inspector.title: Result details
inspector.text: Show first shortfall date, buffer breach, affected goals and comparison assumptions.

FP-06.title: This plan needs more breathing room
FP-06.subtitle: The tested scenario breaches your chosen cash floor.

sections.title: Distinct conditions
sections.text: A buffer breach is different from an overdraft. Show both clearly.

FP-06.title: Your situation changed. Your plan can adapt.
FP-06.subtitle: A revised proposal with every change explained.

sections.title: Same budget, new priorities
sections.text: $700 + $200 + $500 = $1,400. The new reserve reduces optional allocations; it does not create money.

inspector.title: Follow the evidence
inspector.text: Open the changed transaction, snapshot and recalculated forecast.

inspector.title: Choose
inspector.text: Accept revision or keep the previous plan. A failed repair never replaces it.

FP-06.title: Your payoff result, line by line
FP-06.subtitle: A cent-rounded schedule with an adjusted final payment.

sections.title: Result conventions
sections.text: $10,000 principal; 6% nominal annual interest rate; 36 end-of-month payments; no fees; interest rounded half-up to cents per period. Last payment clears the balance.

inspector.title: Compare an extra payment
inspector.text: A $100 monthly extra should shorten the schedule and reduce total interest. Recalculate through the same schedule engine.

inspector.title: Rate is not fee-inclusive APR
inspector.text: The rate used for interest accrual must be explicit. Do not substitute a fee-inclusive advertised APR without disclosure.

FP-06.title: A savings contribution you can verify
FP-06.subtitle: Show what is required and whether the current budget supports it.

sections.title: Formula and final adjustment
sections.text: ($8,000 - $2,400) / 12 = $466.666… . Round the recurring amount up; cap the final contribution to the remaining target. Positive yield uses effective monthly APY conversion.

inspector.title: Feasibility is separate
inspector.text: Compare the required contribution against unallocated monthly income. Show a shortfall if it does not fit.

inspector.title: Already funded
inspector.text: When current savings already covers the target, required contribution is $0.

FP-07.title: Your financial team is at work
FP-07.subtitle: Specialists collaborate on one coordinated result.

sections.title: Scope and cancellation
sections.text: Cancel stops new model/tool calls. Completed results remain visible.

inspector.title: Trace
inspector.text: Show concise real tool events and timing, not hidden chain-of-thought.

inspector.title: Source labels
inspector.text: Live inference can analyze simulated financial records; label both independently.

FP-07.title: A plan, backed by evidence
FP-07.subtitle: Findings are prioritized by what matters next.

inspector.title: Three agent outcomes
inspector.text: Completed / needs information / failed are distinct, with skipped roles explained.

inspector.title: Evidence gate
inspector.text: Unsupported amounts or unknown source IDs cannot become accepted findings.

FP-07.title: Why this finding exists
FP-07.subtitle: Records, calculations and assumptions in one place.

sections.title: Reproducible calculation
sections.text: $350 - $1,250 = -$900. Forecast horizon, date ordering and account scope are explicit.

inspector.title: Freshness
inspector.text: Snapshot 1. Changing or disconnecting records makes this finding stale.

inspector.title: No secret data
inspector.text: Passwords, OTPs and session tokens never enter evidence or model context.

FP-07.title: Ask about your next move
FP-07.subtitle: A conversation connected to the agent workflow.

sections.title: Conversation
rows: You: Why is there a shortfall when I have savings?
FinPilot: The payment is from checking. Savings is separate; no transfer is assumed.
FinPilot: I can request a planning run using that constraint.

sections.title: Message
rows: Explain a finding or request a checkup

inspector.title: Basic chat scope
inspector.text: Read current data, explain findings, clarify goals and request runs.

inspector.title: Authorization
inspector.text: A message does not authorize money movement or replace explicit plan acceptance.

FP-07.title: Some results are ready
FP-07.subtitle: One specialist failed; the rest of your data stays useful.

sections.title: Honest fallback
sections.text: Sample offers are labeled. An unavailable model is not replaced by scripted success.

inspector.title: Retry boundary
inspector.text: Retry only affected work on a compatible snapshot; preserve accepted plans.

FP-08.title: Your workspace, your access
FP-08.subtitle: Manage profile, verification and institution consent.

inspector.title: Security changes
inspector.text: Email or credential changes need reauthentication and are outside scope unless safely implemented.

inspector.title: Session control
inspector.text: Sign out invalidates the server session.

FP-08.title: Disconnect Chase?
FP-08.subtitle: Revoke FinPilot access without closing a bank account.

sections.title: Affected plans
sections.text: Findings and plans depending on these accounts become stale; rerun after reconnecting.

inspector.title: Explicit confirmation
inspector.text: Disconnect or cancel. Prevent repeated requests from producing inconsistent state.

FP-08.title: Start with your first connection
FP-08.subtitle: No financial data is shared until you select accounts and consent.

sections.title: No fabricated metrics
sections.text: Do not show $0 net worth as a meaningful conclusion when data is missing.

inspector.title: Clear recovery
inspector.text: The empty state points to the next useful action, not a dead end.

FP-08.title: The same decisions, on a smaller screen
FP-08.subtitle: Responsive behavior and accessibility are part of the product.

sections.title: Responsive rules
rows: Inputs then results; sticky compare action
Separate drawer, not over key controls

sections.title: Review checklist
sections.text: 390px mobile and 1440px desktop screenshots; 200% zoom; keyboard focus; accessible labels; reduced motion.

inspector.title: Feedback states
inspector.text: Loading / empty / validation error / provider failure / stale data / success.

inspector.title: Charts
inspector.text: Provide text summaries and tabular values alongside color-coded charts.
